question_cn: 象兵对王，白方胜利的关键条件是：
question_en: Bishop and pawn vs. king — White's key winning condition is:

options.text_cn: 象先到达升变格，兵随后跟上
options.text_en: Bishop reaches promotion square first, pawn follows

options.text_cn: 白王走在兵的前面开路，象控制关键斜线
options.text_en: White king leads the pawn, bishop controls key diagonals
Pawn advances alone, bishop only protects
Checkmate the enemy king before advancing the pawn

explanation_cn: 象兵对王的胜利路线：王在前开路排除对方王干扰，象在后控制斜线防止对方王切入。两者配合是胜利的元思维框架。
explanation_en: Meta-framework: king leads to clear the way, bishop controls diagonals to prevent the enemy king from interfering.
